Game Overview

Daddy Rabbit is a animal title where guide Daddy Rabbit through a captivating underground maze to rescue his bunnies. Strategically balance stealth and quick reflexes, staying close to his adorable charges to avoid alerting zombies. Use tap controls for epic carrot punches, ensuring the safety of all baby bunnies in this charming yet spooky adventure.
